command:
set -euo pipefail
WORK=/tmp/f2-live-voice-runtime-candidate
STAR=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star
rm -rf "$WORK"
git clone -q --branch chatgpt-live-emotion-20260912 --single-branch https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/clay-global-research-entity.git "$WORK"
cd "$WORK"
python3 tests/test_chatgpt_live_voice_expression.py
python3 tests/test_chatgpt_live_voice_state_adapter.py
python3 /tmp/patch_runtime_voice.py
PYTHONPATH="$WORK/research_entity/coordination:$STAR" python3 -m py_compile /tmp/f2wp1207_chatgpt_organ.voice.new.py
PYTHONPATH="$WORK/research_entity/coordination:$STAR" python3 - <<'PY'
import importlib.util
p='/tmp/f2wp1207_chatgpt_organ.voice.new.py'
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('organ_voice_candidate', p)
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
cases=[
 ('Flüster das bitte.', {}, 'whisper-like'),
 ('Schrei das jetzt!', {}, 'shout-like'),
 ('Nein, hör auf damit und sprich normal.', {'cell_states':{'affect':{'anger':0.94}}}, 'natural, calm'),
 ('Was jetzt?', {'cell_states':{'affect':{'anger':0.94}}}, 'shout-like'),
 ('Lach ruhig kurz darüber.', {}, 'natural chuckle or laugh'),
]
for text, extra, needle in cases:
    cap={'turn_event_id':'smoke-turn', **extra}
    out=m.build_grid_instruction(text, cap, 'smoke-run')
    assert 'VOICE_EXPRESSION_INTENT=' in out
    assert 'VOICE_EXPRESSION_GUIDANCE=' in out
    assert needle in out, (text, needle)
    print(text, '=>', needle, 'PASS')
print('CANDIDATE_SHA')
import hashlib
print(hashlib.sha256(open(p,'rb').read()).hexdigest())
PY
printf 'BRANCH_HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
